Menu notes · Bahattar journal

A small guide to the menu.

Use category filters, compare prices in NPR, and understand flavour options and add-ons.

A useful menu helps you narrow a choice without making you guess about prices or extras. Bahattar Cafe’s complete menu keeps the supplied item names, prices, flavour choices, and ingredient descriptions together.

Start with a category or search

On the complete menu page, choose a category such as World of Espresso, Momo, or Breakfast. To find a specific item, type its name or flavour into the search field. Search applies within the selected category; choose “All items” to search the entire menu.

Read the price in NPR

“Rs.” means Nepalese Rupees on this website. The number beside an item is its supplied menu price. For example, Cafe Latte is Rs. 165 and American Breakfast is Rs. 525. The supplied information does not confirm taxes or service charges; ask the café about the final bill.

Separate flavours from add-ons

Flavour Latte lists Vanilla, Caramel, and Hazelnut options at the item’s listed Rs. 265 price. Add Flavour is a separate add-on at Rs. 100. Do not add these figures together unless the café confirms that an extra charge applies to your particular order.

Similarly, the American Breakfast description includes coffee or tea, while the toast items have no supplied included-drink description. Read the description for the item you select rather than extending one item’s inclusions to another.

Check ingredients and availability

Only some items have complete supplied descriptions. A short item name cannot establish allergens, portion size, or substitutions. Call the café if you need a specific answer, and confirm the current price and availability when ordering.
